previousRun.exclude: Exclude every previous sentence ID, normalized reference and filename from both splits. Also exclude all publisher validation sentence IDs/references from the test pool, not only the selected validation subset.

selection.rule: Within each eligible split group by sentence ID; choose one recording per sentence by lowest SHA256(seed+'|clip|'+filename). Rank groups by SHA256(seed+'|'+split+'|sentence|'+sentenceId). Choose fixed counts without duration, transcript-quality or outcome filtering. Fail on duplicate normalized reference or converted audio hash across chosen groups; never replace failed cases.

inference.runner: Comparison-only runner imports unchanged server/ml/transcribe.py:transcribe with an explicitly selected model. Same browser-payload validation, subprocess timeout, decoding, VAD, segment gates, language id, beam=3, temperature=0 and CPU int8/two threads for both candidates.
inference.audio: All selected recordings converted with unchanged PCM converter to s16 mono 16kHz WAV, without cropping/denoise/loudness normalization. Keep rejections/errors as empty hypotheses.

decision.chooseBaseIf: Base validation micro WER is at least 10 percent relatively lower than Tiny, Base has no infrastructure errors, rejected-count does not exceed Tiny, and Base adapter p95 <= 15000ms. Otherwise keep Tiny. No changing this rule after seeing validation.
decision.testPolicy: Write immutable decision.json and its hash before any new test inference. Evaluate both fixed candidates on the same untouched test sample; never alter the decision based on test outcomes.
decision.runtimePolicy: Comparison is research only. No automatic app model replacement, training or business-data mutation.

scoring.primary: micro WER across all selected recordings including failed transcripts as empty
scoring.timing: Cold subprocess per clip, sequential, model order alternates for successive records. Includes Python/model initialization; excludes browser, HTTP and preparation. Background workload is not controlled.

verification.repeatSelection: First two test clips in frozen order for both models; no whole-sample repeat claim.

limitations: New unscored sentence groups, not an independent dataset or an independently audited speaker split.
Public read speech does not measure menu/quantity/negation safety, owner microphones or noisy kedai use.
The old FLEURS sample and Tiny failure are known. Pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
Small validation/test samples, no claim of statistical significance or general production accuracy.
Once scored, these groups are observed and cannot be recycled as untouched tests for tuning.
